title: Priscilla & Tiffany's Art Academy

services.name: Kids Art Classes
services.desc: Our kids classes are designed for young artists ages 5-12 who love to create, explore, and get a little messy with art. In our relaxed and inspiring studio, students experiment with sketching, drawing, and painting while discovering new techniques and materials. Along the way, they’ll learn about famous artists, creative styles, and the stories behind great works of art. Each class encourages imagination, confidence, and creative thinking while kids build real artistic skills. Most importantly, our studio is a place where kids feel inspired, supported, and excited to create. Painting is a way for children to do many important things: convey ideas, use their senses, explore color, explore
